verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official MCP server plus Snyk Studio hooks for agentic IDEs, explicitly instructing users to prompt their coding agent in natural language (e.g. "scan my directory for security issues"), and supports slash commands like /snyk-fix and /snyk-batch-fix plus an LLM-driven Remediation Agent that plans and applies fixes conversationally. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands reliably work end-to-end outside vendor docs.
